issue.title: [ACL] Add a testcase for DATAACL rule validation on backend testbeds

failure.body:
**Description**
Test gap for the issue: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/3078

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Create DATAACL table and add a forward rule matching input interface (eg. Ethernet0)
2. Verify that traffic ingressing Ethernet0 is forwarded
3. Verify that traffic ingressing on any other interface is dropped

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Add an explicit testcase to validate that acl is loaded successfully on the backend T0 testbed. Without this case, acl load failure was determined by examining the nighly run failures on the backend testbed
